title: BMUnun 致 Indianyn Krdagy elchisi menen rasmiy zholugushuu otkordu 校长

blocks.text: 比什凯克马姆莱凯蒂克大学校长、教授米尔兰·迪尔达耶夫（Mirlan Dyldaev）吉尔吉斯共和国联合体印度共和国儿子atayin zhana yigarym ukuktuu elchisi Birender Singh Yadav myrza menen印度elchiliginde zholugushuu otkordЯ。

Zholugushuunun zharshhad taraptar 印度 שkmשth tarabynan sunushtalgan bilim beru 程序性 boyuncha pikir almashyshyp、eki olkonun zhogorku bilim beru mekemeleri ortosundagy kyzmattashtykty Myndan ary terendetu我会说话。 Oshondoy ele Kyrgyzstan menen Indianyn ortosundagy dostuk zana oz ara thishnishshish mamilelerin onkturnishi belgilenip, madaniy zhana academylyk baylanyshtardy chydoo maseleleri karaldy.
Bul zholugushuu eki taraptuu kyzmattashtyktyn myndan ary keneyishine chon salym koshooru kutuluhado。
